architecture.web: Next/vinext + Vite, shared TypeScript Studio/document/rendering engine, browser Canvas/WebGL and file APIs
architecture.desktop: Tauri UI shell with native file dialogs/IPC and Rust f32 compositor for eligible exports
architecture.persistence: Luma project ZIP format, serial/coalesced save queues, IndexedDB autosave/recovery, operation-history snapshots

supported_workflows: Layer-based raster, text, shape, path, group, adjustment and smart-object editing per README
Save/reopen .luma projects with bounded decoding and recovery paths
PNG/JPEG/WebP, PDF/SVG, PSD/PSB and supported RAW import/export paths with format-specific limits
Web and Tauri desktop editing; native file dialogs are desktop-only
unsupported_or_partial: CMYK/N-channel editing and arbitrary device-link ICC transforms
General multilayer high-depth PSD writing; current high-depth paths are narrowly eligible or compatibility conversions
Documents beyond canvas limits: selection/mask/transform operations remain guarded
Complete Photoshop/third-party plugin ecosystem and independent >=50-project compatibility qualification
Packaged desktop signing/notarization, updater failure campaign, remote crash receipt and clean-machine installation are not evidenced by current artifacts
